items.description: The Chapel of Nossa Senhora de Baluarte on Mozambique Island is one of the oldest European buildings in Southern Africa.
Maputo Cathedral is a city landmark with unique architecture, combining historical and religious significance.
Vila Algarve in Maputo is a historic mansion known for its colonial architecture and abandoned status.
Polana Church is a historic church in Maputo, noted for its unique design and community role.
The Inhambane Mosque is an ancient mosque reflecting Islamic influence in coastal Mozambique, dating back centuries.
The Macuti Lighthouse in Beira is a historical navigational aid and a prominent landmark on the coast.
Maputo City Hall is an iconic architectural landmark in the capital, reflecting Portuguese colonial design.
The Cathedral of Beira is an impressive religious structure, showcasing the architectural diversity of the city.
Palacio de São Paulo on Mozambique Island is a beautifully restored colonial palace and a key historical attraction.
Gorongosa National Park is a flagship conservation success, renowned for its diverse wildlife and ecosystem restoration.
Limpopo National Park is part of the Great Limpopo Transfrontier Park, an international conservation area.
Bazaruto Archipelago is a marine reserve known for pristine coral reefs, dolphins, and dugongs.
Quirimbas Archipelago is famous for its historic islands, pristine beaches, and rich marine biodiversity.
Zinave National Park is a key wildlife sanctuary in southern Mozambique, noted for its elephant population.
Banhine National Park is a large wetland area in southern Mozambique, known for its diverse birdlife.
